title: UK CPI Inflation Rises to 3.6% in October, a One-Year High, on Fuel Prices
detail: The ONS published its October 2026 figures on 18 November: CPI inflation rose to 3.6% from 3.5% in September, with fuel prices the main upward pressure. Core CPI was reported at 2.8% and food inflation fell to 0.9%, its slowest since September 2021. The next release is due on 16 December.

media.caption: UK inflation hits highest point in a year
